messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I want a fair financial share, and I haven’t agreed to a discounted purchase that leaves me subsidizing A. B shouldn’t be overlooked either. I’d like it settled, but there’s no rush; I don’t want this to damage things with my twin. Your wording is close—please say “fair to all three of us,” not just that nobody is worse off.
I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount. A good outcome would be a fair arrangement that C also agrees to. I’m worried about moving ahead before she’s comfortable.

I’d quite like a fair arrangement that leaves me with money to get a dance studio started; that’s the main thing I’m hoping for. I’m not sure what amount or arrangement is possible, and I’d worry about things dragging on without a clear plan.

Not quite. Please include that I want a fair financial share and haven’t agreed to subsidize A’s discounted purchase. No rush, even if A is eager. The main problem would be moving ahead with that discount without my agreement.
Yes, that wording fits. The discount would make buying the house more affordable for us; it’s not about credit for past contributions.
That mostly fits. The studio matters because it would be something of my own and give me more independence. I suppose I worry my plans could get lost while the house is being sorted out.
#1 fits. I’m not rushed, and I don’t agree to any discounted purchase unless I freely agree to it.
Yes, #3 fits. Nothing else comes to mind right now.

I can’t confirm C’s rewording for her; the current wording seems fair to me. O2 is the one I could consider, subject to the numbers and C’s agreement. I’m not comfortable assuming C or B should wait for money, so O3 would need their free agreement too. O1 and O5 don’t give me the affordability discount I’m hoping for.

In principle, O1 or O2 sound clearest to me; O5 could work too. I’d be uneasy with O3 if payment is delayed, and O4 unless the funding and timetable for my studio are clear. I can’t commit to either without those details.

The reframe fits as a principle, not a settled calculation. I could consider O1, O2, O4 or O5; O2 isn’t my agreement to a discounted purchase yet. I’m not comfortable with O3 unless the deferred payments are secure and the terms work for me. No rush from my side.
